summary: Borr Drilling Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, announcing the publication of an investor presentation on its website. The filing is a routine 6-K report of a foreign private issuer; it contains no agreements, transactions, or structural changes. The press release describes the company's business and provides contact information for inquiries. No deal terms, board recommendations, or special-situation events are disclosed. This is an ordinary disclosure, not a special situation.
